cohort: 114 women who underwent vNOTES hysterectomy for benign gynecologic disease with a uterine weight of 280 g or more on pathologic examination
finding: vNOTES hysterectomy was found to be a safe and effective alternative to laparoscopy or laparotomy in cases with a large uterus, even in patients with a history of cesarean section, obesity, or nulliparity.
